query:
insert into
                user_signups (id, login, email, created_at, expires_at)
            values
                ($1, lower($2), lower($3), now(), $4)
            on conflict (login) do update set
                login = excluded.login,
                email = excluded.email,
                created_at = now(),
                expires_at = $4
            returning
                id,
                login,
                email,
                created_at,
                expires_at
